name: Safari Coffee Outpost
notes: All 3 photos are the same coffee-kiosk price board (photos 2 and 3 are the same revision shot twice; photo 1 is an older/different-priced revision). It lists espresso drinks, sodas, bottled water and generic snack categories (fresh baked cookies, assorted pastries, ice cream novelties, dippin' dots, chips, mini donuts) with no specific prepared dishes — a drink/snack stand, not a menu of dishes.
